confidence_notes: City anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Polish price levels for a mid-sized tourist city in July (high season), not from live listings or current menus. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies more by season and venue. FX limitation: the only RBA observation I could verify on the official rba.gov.au exchange-rates page is dated 2025-12-31, about 9.5 months before the 2026-10-16 generation date, so it is likely stale and the server should refresh it before any conversion. Secondary sites showed October 2026 USD/AUD figures, but I could not confirm them on the RBA page, so I did not use them.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Polish and Central European cities with comparable tourism demand, such as Krakow, Poznan and Gdansk, adjusted to Wroclaw's price level. Accommodation anchors reflect July peak-season pricing.
